:::: {.bms-tool-area}

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const allowedOrigin = "https://backgammon-made-simple.shinyapps.io";
  const iframeId = "bms-position-preview-frame";
  const heightMessageType = "bms-iframe-height";
  const requestMessageType = "bms-request-height";

  function getIframe() {
    return document.getElementById(iframeId);
  }

  window.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (event.origin !== allowedOrigin) {
      return;
    }

    const data = event.data;

    if (
      !data ||
      data.type !== heightMessageType ||
      data.source !== "position-dashboard"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const height = Number(data.height);

    if (!Number.isFinite(height) || height < 120 || height > 50000) {
      return;
    }

    const iframe = getIframe();

    if (iframe) {
      iframe.style.height = `${Math.ceil(height) + 2}px`;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const iframe = getIframe();

    if (!iframe) {
      return;
    }

    iframe.addEventListener("load", function () {
      iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(
        { type: requestMessageType },
        allowedOrigin
      );
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
